name: Grauer Bär
beschreibung:
Centrally located in Innsbruck, Hotel Grauer Baer welcomes city travellers and mountain enthusiasts with sleek rooms and an outstanding 5th-floor spa area featuring a panoramic pool facing the Nordkette peaks.

The historic Old Town, the Imperial Palace Hofburg, the State Theatre, and the Hungerburg funicular are an easy walk away.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Grauer Baer in Innsbruck offers contemporary comfort and a rooftop panoramic pool overlooking the city.
